name: Quote B3
author: Giuliano-sn
description: Live prices for up to 3 Brazilian B3 stocks, BRL currency pairs or the Ibovespa in the bar, with trend arrows and optional high/low price alerts. Defaults to USDBRL and EURBRL.

barWidget.description: Shows up to 3 assets (B3 stocks, BRL currency pairs or IBOV) as NAME ▲ price, with optional high/low alerts that notify and chime once on crossing. Left-click for details, right-click to pick assets by typing their name, middle-click to refresh.
